nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route exposing GET/POST handlers for affiliate records, persisted via a Supabase client resolved at request time.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Accepts an affiliate submission, validates required fields, and inserts the row into the affiliates Supabase table.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Massive agency assistant chat endpoint that orchestrates context assembly, tool routing, triage spec generation, and streaming responses for the agency operator UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Single 1854-line POST handler implements multiple inline state machines for triage, brief-status, performance, and action-result UI specs.

nodes.name: stripVoidAssistantTurns
nodes.summary: Filters trailing assistant messages whose content is empty so they do not poison downstream LLM prompts.

nodes.name: actionsForTriageItem
nodes.summary: Derives the per-item action buttons (review, dismiss, escalate) attached to triage spec entries based on item type and state.

nodes.name: buildTriageSpec
nodes.summary: Constructs the full triage UI specification payload (sections, items, actions, summary) consumed by the agency dashboard.

nodes.name: tryBuildTriageStream
nodes.summary: Attempts to detect a triage intent in the conversation and, when matched, returns a streamed triage spec response.

nodes.name: tryBuildActionResultStream
nodes.summary: Detects an action-result confirmation from the last user message and streams the corresponding success/failure UI spec.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Main agency-chat POST handler — authenticates, assembles context, routes through tool registry and proactive engine, and streams the assistant response.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Generates content briefs in bulk for every client of an agency, running each through the variant generator and adversarial evaluator.

nodes.name: generateBriefsForClient
nodes.summary: For a single client, generates brief variants, scores them with the adversarial evaluator, and persists the surviving briefs.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Validates the request, fans out brief generation across all clients of the calling agency, and returns aggregate results.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Endpoints for the agency operator to fetch pending briefs awaiting review and to approve, reject, or edit them.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the queue of briefs in pending-review state for the current agency, joined with client metadata.

nodes.name: PATCH
nodes.summary: Applies an operator decision (approve, reject, edit) to a brief, persists the change, and triggers email send on approval.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: CRUD endpoints for agency-scoped long-term memory entries used to ground the agency assistant across sessions.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Lists the memory entries for the calling agency, optionally filtered by tag or scope.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Creates a new memory entry for the agency after validating payload and scope ownership.

nodes.name: PATCH
nodes.summary: Updates an existing memory entry, verifying it belongs to the calling agency before persisting changes.

nodes.name: DELETE
nodes.summary: Deletes a memory entry by id after verifying agency ownership.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Generates a short-form video script via an LLM, gated by subscription tier and using shared API helper utilities.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Validates input, calls the script generation LLM with subscription-aware prompts, and returns the produced script.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Returns prioritized algorithm-IQ insights for the user with create, list, and update endpoints, plus helpers for icon/color metadata.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Loads insights from storage, filters by category/severity, decorates each with display metadata, and returns the prioritized list.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Creates a new insight entry for the user from caller-supplied type, message, and severity.

nodes.name: PATCH
nodes.summary: Updates an existing insight (dismiss, mark read, change severity) by id.

nodes.name: getInsightIcon
nodes.summary: Maps an insight type string to its corresponding icon identifier for the UI.

nodes.name: getInsightColor
nodes.summary: Maps an insight type string to a UI color token for severity-aware styling.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Exposes performance metrics for the user's algorithm-IQ predictions with GET to read and POST to record new performance samples.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Aggregates prediction-vs-actual stats, calibration deltas, and per-component accuracy into a single performance payload.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Records a new performance sample (actual outcome for a prediction) tied to the calling user.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Runs the algorithm-IQ self-audit pipeline that inspects recent predictions for failure patterns, component issues, and recommended adjustments.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a self-audit run: gathers worst predictions, calls pattern/issue detectors, and persists generated insights and adjustments.

nodes.name: analyzeFailurePatterns
nodes.summary: Scans recent predictions for recurring failure signatures (over-prediction, niche miscalibration, etc.) and tags each cluster.

nodes.name: detectComponentIssues
nodes.summary: Inspects per-component reliability across recent predictions to surface components that are systematically miscalibrated.

nodes.name: generateAutoAdjustments
nodes.summary: Translates detected patterns and component issues into proposed calibration adjustments to be applied to future runs.

nodes.name: generateAuditInsights
nodes.summary: Produces user-facing insight strings summarizing the audit's findings and recommended actions.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the most recent self-audit report for the calling user, with optional filtering by run id.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Records and updates algorithm-IQ tracking events linking predictions to subsequent actual outcomes and engagement.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Creates a new tracking record tying a prediction id to user/video metadata, then enqueues follow-up actions.

nodes.name: generateInsight
nodes.summary: Builds a synthetic insight summarizing the tracked prediction's accuracy relative to the actual outcome.

nodes.name: PATCH
nodes.summary: Updates an existing tracking row with actual outcome data and recomputes derived accuracy metrics.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Produces human-readable explanations for a prediction by analysing executed components, building a decision tree, and surfacing top performers and weak spots.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Loads a stored prediction by id, walks its components against the reliability map, and returns a structured explanation payload.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Runs a live prediction through the Kai orchestrator and returns the explanation alongside the prediction in a single call.

nodes.name: analyzeComponents
nodes.summary: Joins each executed component with its reliability score and emits a per-component analysis record.

nodes.name: buildDecisionTree
nodes.summary: Constructs a structured decision tree representation of how the prediction's components reached the final score.

nodes.name: generateExplanation
nodes.summary: Composes the final natural-language explanation string from the analysed components and decision tree.

nodes.name: generateRealtimeExplanation
nodes.summary: Produces a streamlined explanation for fresh, in-flight prediction results returned from the orchestrator.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Lightweight rate-limited endpoint that returns the current 'algorithm weather' status banner consumed by the dashboard.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny stub endpoint accepting an instant-analysis request and echoing a minimal acknowledgement payload.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Compares expert-curated analytics against the automated pipeline, returning side-by-side scores and allowing manual overrides.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Loads expert and automated analytics for the current user and returns them aligned by template/sound id.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Persists an expert override or correction and recomputes the comparison row via the expert analytics pipeline.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Returns aggregated newsletter engagement statistics (sends, opens, clicks, churn) for the current account from Supabase.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Queries Supabase for newsletter activity in the requested window and aggregates raw events into engagement metrics.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Returns synthetic sound-category analytics for a configurable time range to power the audio dashboard.

nodes.name: generateSoundCategoryData
nodes.summary: Generates the per-category sound analytics rows (counts, growth, engagement) for the requested time range.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Parses the time-range query parameter and returns the corresponding sound category dataset.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Returns sound-by-sound engagement correlation data with optional category filter, min engagement threshold, and sort key.

nodes.name: generateCorrelationData
nodes.summary: Builds the sound engagement correlation dataset, filtering by category and min engagement and sorting by the requested key.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Parses filter/sort query params and delegates to the correlation data generator before returning the result.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Returns growth trajectory data for a specific sound across the requested time range with optional compare-mode baseline.

nodes.name: generateSoundGrowthData
nodes.summary: Generates the time-series growth dataset for a sound, optionally including a comparison baseline series.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Parses sound id, time range, and compare mode from the query string and returns the growth dataset.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Records a template-usage analytics event into Firebase from the client, used for downstream template popularity metrics.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Validates the usage payload and writes a template-usage event document to Firebase.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Merges sound and template analysis services into a single 'unified score' payload with score-based recommendation strings.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Loads sound and template analyses for the requested ids, merges them into unified scores, and decorates each with recommendations.

nodes.name: getRecommendation
nodes.summary: Maps a numeric score and metric type to a human-readable recommendation string.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Thin analytics endpoint that delegates report generation to the monitoring analytics-reporting library and returns the JSON.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Stub endpoint that forwards an apply-fixes request to the scoring service and returns the result.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Returns a static list of analyze-tool example payloads used by the docs and onboarding UI.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Top-level analyze endpoint that runs content through the scoring service under the configured SLA budget.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Analyses a template via Claude with a deterministic mock fallback, returning remix suggestions consumed by the template editor.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Validates the template request, dispatches to Claude or the mock generator, and returns the structured remix response.

nodes.name: generateClaudeResponse
nodes.summary: Builds the Claude prompt for the template, invokes the API, and parses the response into the remix schema.

nodes.name: generateMockResponse
nodes.summary: Returns a deterministic mock remix response used when the Anthropic key is missing or the LLM call fails.
